WHATWG HTML Living Standard, “Rendering”

The current specification of how browsers are expected to display unstyled HTML, including link blue and visited purple.

Context

The expected style sheet contains :link { color: #0000EE; } and :visited { color: #551A8B; }.

It sets :heading(1) { margin-block: 0.67em; font-size: 2.00em; }, the same h1 size as CSS 2 Appendix D.

Why it belongs

The source for the primary and secondary colors in the Brutalist web design tokens.
